title: Neural active learning guides stronger bone-scaffold architectures
summary: Learned architecture models and finite-element simulations guided fabrication of scaffold subunits. A larger scaffold assembled through human adaptation of the learned structures showed about 20% greater load-bearing capacity than the uniform comparator. This is a mechanical bench-test result, not evidence of implantation, bone healing or clinical benefit.
ai_technology: GAD-MALL autoencoder and convolutional active learning
organization: Tsinghua University; Peking University; Max Planck Institute for Iron Research
